visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera shows a storefront facade with a black vertical sign labeled '阿明肉包' and a red awning. A staff member in a white shirt and black apron stands behind a service counter with customers waiting. (2) Close-up of a white steamed bun being pulled apart by two hands, revealing a thick, stretchy yellow cheese filling that forms a long bridge. (3) A woman with a purple mask and blue headband points at various buns inside a stainless steel warming cabinet. The cabinet contains rows of white, dark brown, and green buns. (4) A sequence of close-ups shows different buns being broken open: a dark brown bun with a syrupy center, a white bun with black sesame paste, a meat bun containing a whole orange egg yolk, and a white bun stuffed with vegetables and glass noodles. (5) The woman is seen packing multiple white buns into brown paper bags on the counter. The video concludes with a shot of the shop exterior overlaid with address information.
